## Program

`CLAUDE.md` in every repository becomes a pointer to `AGENTS.md` and carries nothing else — one instruction set per repo, maintained once. Each repo is one sub-issue (规则 2: a cross-repo change is never one dispatch); this card is the coordination node and is never dispatched.

| repo | sub-issue | state on 2026-09-09 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| objectstack | filed below | `CLAUDE.md` 41 lines: pointer + inlined never-miss rules with hook pointers; `scripts/pm/check-governed-prose.mjs` counts it as an instruction surface that must name the five governed surfaces |
| objectui | filed below | `CLAUDE.md` 25 lines: pointer + two inlined rules with hook pointers; `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` lists it as governed |
| hotcrm | filed below (folded into the AGENTS.md trim) | no `CLAUDE.md` at all; `.github/copilot-instructions.md` is already the pointer model |
| cloud · objectos · www.objectos.ai | filed below | not readable from this session at filing; the sub-issue's first step is to measure whether a `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md` pair exists |

Fixed shape for every sub-issue: the file says where the truth lives and that the reader must read it, in the repo's own instruction language; ⛔ no rule is restated in it, no hook list, no digest. Hooks and gates keep enforcing what they enforce (the never-miss rules live in `AGENTS.md` and in the hooks, not in the pointer). A gate that reads `CLAUDE.md` as an instruction surface adapts to the pointer form in the same PR. `CLAUDE.md` is a governed surface in every repo ⇒ draft PR, human merge, `skip-changeset` where the repo has it.

Governing text: the maintainer instruction above; AGENTS.md (each repo) as the single source it points to. Four-axis note recorded once here for all sub-issues: 实际业务需求 — the maintainer measured the cost directly (two sets to maintain, drift between them); 长远 — one source; 防 AI 犯错 — an agent that reads only `CLAUDE.md` today gets a digest that can lag `AGENTS.md`, and a pointer cannot lag; 不扩散 — deletion, no new surface. The known cost, stated: Claude Code loads `CLAUDE.md` automatically and `AGENTS.md` only through the pointer, so a session that skips the pointer has no rules until a hook fires — the hooks are the floor that makes this acceptable.
